segments.name: Fashion e-commerce platform
segments.description: Online retailer selling fashion and footwear on Amazon as a third-party seller, managing excess inventory.
segments.evidence: The Fashion e-commerce platform which represents Orgad's activity that was acquired by the Company in 2022, mainly operates on Amazon.

segments.name: SaaS solutions
segments.evidence: Naiz Fit is our AI-driven size and fit technology platform, or the Naiz Fit Platform, serving as the technology backbone of the MySize group.

segments.name: resale platform for apparel
segments.description: Managed second-hand fashion recommerce platform for brands and consumers across Southern and Central Europe.
segments.evidence: Percentil, acquired through our wholly-owned Spanish subsidiary New Percentil in May 2025, is a managed recommerce platform founded in Spain in 2012 that gives pre-owned fashion a second life.

segments.name: wholesaling of footwear
segments.description: Wholesaling of footwear, one of the company's four reporting segments.
segments.evidence: The Company operates its business through four reporting segments: (i) fashion e-commerce platform, (ii) SaaS solutions (iii) resale platform and (iv) wholesale.

revenueModel.text: Orgad's revenue comes almost entirely from selling fashion and footwear through the Amazon marketplace.
revenueModel.evidence: Orgad manages more than 5,000 SKUs across footwear, apparel, and accessories, and substantially all of its revenue is generated through the Amazon marketplace.

changes.text: In 2025 the company added a new resale platform reporting unit.
changes.evidence: No goodwill impairment was recorded for other reporting unit including the new reporting units – resale platform.
